summary: Completed comprehensive testing of DulceSal pastry e-commerce website. Backend APIs working correctly with 6 products, testimonials, site config, contact form, and order creation. Frontend cart functionality working with toast notifications but cart sidebar has display issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Cart sidebar not opening when cart icon clicked, despite cart functionality working
ui_bugs.selector: Cart icon with shopping cart SVG

integration_issues.issue: Testimonials not visible on frontend despite API returning 3 testimonials

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/config - returns complete site configuration
Backend: POST /api/contact - successfully saves contact messages
Backend: POST /api/orders - creates orders with order numbers
Frontend: Page loads with correct vintage pink styling
Frontend: Products load from API and display correctly
Frontend: Add to cart functionality works with toast notifications
Frontend: Contact form accepts input and submits
Frontend: Checkout page shows empty cart state correctly
success_percentage: Backend: 85.7% (6/7 tests passed), Frontend: 75% (cart sidebar issue affects user experience)
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix cart sidebar not opening when cart icon is clicked - investigate CartSidebar component and cart toggle functionality. Also fix testimonials not displaying on frontend despite API working correctly.
